entries.title: Created MSPortfolio (MCP-Native Portfolio)
entries.rootCause: — (new initiative, not an incident)
entries.fix: Repo ManSio/MSPortfolio: static site (React 19/Vite 8/Tailwind v4, GH Pages) + MCP server (@modelcontextprotocol/server@2 + Fastify, Streamable HTTP, 6 tools) + browser agent demo with trace + architecture simulator + CI (deploy + hourly metrics refresh).
entries.guard: verified_from_clean_state: git clone → pnpm install → pnpm build; MCP smoke via curl.

entries.title: Spec wrongly proposed the Fastify package @fastify/mcp
entries.rootCause: The package does not exist on npm; official Fastify support is @modelcontextprotocol/fastify (middleware v2).
entries.fix: Used @modelcontextprotocol/fastify@2 (createMcpFastifyApp + toNodeHandler + createMcpHandler) — verified by experiments #1-2.
entries.guard: Check the registry before pinning any dependency.

entries.title: registerTool rejects raw JSON Schema → HTTP 500
entries.rootCause: SDK v2 expects a zod schema; the createMcpHandler factory crashes on registration on every request.
entries.fix: z.fromJSONSchema(tool.inputSchema) at registration (verified: parse OK / invalid caught).
entries.guard: Integration test (tools/list, tools/call) before commit.

entries.title: A fork of someone else's project (infrawise) slipped into the portfolio as 'mine'
entries.rootCause: Project data was taken from users/ManSio/repos without checking the fork flag; infrawise is a fork of Sidd27/infrawise.
entries.fix: Removed from projects/principles/timeline/architecture models; metrics filter forks (live-fetch + update-metrics.ts + snapshot).
entries.guard: fork !== true in both metric paths; verify gh api repos/…/infrawise (fork/source) before including someone else's code.

entries.title: Light theme unreadable (white on white)
entries.rootCause: Components hardcoded dark colors (text-paper = white text) and ignored the light theme; only the body background switched.
entries.fix: Semantic tokens via CSS variables (ink/paper/muted/faint/accent) + @custom-variant dark. Dark theme visually unchanged, light theme readable.
entries.guard: Colors only through semantic classes; no text-paper/\d+ variants.

entries.title: Cloudflare Workers entrypoint (workerd-native MCP)
entries.rootCause: GH Pages is static; the MCP server needs a process host → added a second entrypoint for Workers.
entries.fix: worker/index.ts uses handler.fetch() (web-standard, no toNodeHandler); CORS/OPTIONS/health in the wrapper. Verified 7/7 tests.
entries.guard: wrangler hoisted into npx (its workerd/esbuild build scripts break pnpm deps-check on Windows).

entries.title: mansio.github.io returned 404; pnpm approval in CI
entries.rootCause: The ManSio.github.io repo did not exist — the user site was not set up. pnpm 11 renamed onlyBuiltDependencies → allowBuilds.
entries.fix: Created ManSio.github.io (meta-refresh + JS redirect + canonical) to /MSPortfolio/. allowBuilds: esbuild: true in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
entries.guard: Fresh frozen install + esbuild binary verified.

entries.title: Live deploy: MCP on Cloudflare Workers + user site
entries.fix: wrangler login → mansio-dev.workers.dev subdomain (registered via REST API) → wrangler deploy → https://msp-portfolio.mansio-dev.workers.dev/mcp. Site demo wired to the live endpoint.
entries.guard: CI smoke against the live endpoint; wrangler deploy --dry-run + smoke of the built index.js.

entries.title: SEO/mobile/CTA pass: OG cover, touch targets, mobile check
entries.rootCause: — (owner request: close the SEO-audit items)
entries.fix: og:image (PIL, 1200×630) + twitter:card; 'Let's talk' CTA section; Button got min-h-11 (44px, Apple HIG); mobile check automated via scripts/check-mobile.mjs (headless Edge + CDP).
entries.guard: node scripts/check-mobile.mjs as a layout regression check.

entries.title: Live audit of the MCP endpoint: get_articles 403, no rate limit
entries.rootCause: get_articles — dev.to rejects requests from the Cloudflare worker (200 from a normal IP, 403 from the worker). Rate limiting not implemented (empirically 20×200, 0×429).
entries.fix: NOT fixed yet — found during research (experiments against production). Plan: get_articles → UA + cron-snapshot; rate limit → [[ratelimits]].
entries.guard: extend CI smoke: tools/call get_articles (not just tools/list); experiments — EXPERIMENTS_LOG.md#3-4.

entries.title: get_articles did not show a new article (dev.to Varnish cache)
entries.rootCause: dev.to serves /api/articles through layered Varnish; after publication a stale copy lives in the cache and is served to some egresses. cache:no-store and cache-busters did not help (Varnish normalizes unknown query params).
entries.fix: the real API param state=published changes the Varnish cache key → fresh data. Verified live: worker returns 6 articles.
entries.guard: live check of get_articles; tools/call get_articles smoke already in CI.

entries.title: Analytics Engine enabled and bound; auto-deploy closed with a token
entries.rootCause: — (owner actions closed)
entries.fix: CF API token via gh secret set → deploy-worker GREEN for the first time. Analytics Engine enabled; ANALYTICS binding → msp_portfolio dataset. Live: 3 tools/call → counter today:16.
entries.guard: CI smoke; KNOWN_ISSUES KI-007.

entries.title: Ideas 3/5/6: failure events in the simulator, antipattern museum, terminal
entries.rootCause: — (feature batch)
entries.fix: Simulator emits failure-mode events (circuit_open, fallback_engaged, degraded_mode, cache_miss). Antipattern museum: 7 incidents + get_antipatterns tool. Terminal: commands over the tools.
entries.guard: tests 36/36; live validation: tools/list 9, antipatterns count 7.

entries.title: CI: refresh metrics before build; live validation of new features
entries.rootCause: 'Refresh metrics snapshot' ran after 'Build' — every deploy shipped the previous run's snapshot.
entries.fix: moved the step before Build (deploy.yml). Live validation: get_commit_history → source:snapshot, count:15; /mcp/stats → today:6/total:6.
entries.guard: tools/list smoke (get_commit_history) + tools/call get_articles.

entries.title: Features: get_commit_history, decision-log narrative, agent counter (/mcp/stats)
entries.rootCause: — (feature batch)
entries.fix: Commit snapshot in update-metrics.ts; decision-log narrative in ProjectsGrid; KV counter MCP_STATS + /mcp/stats. Incident: fire-and-forget void promise without ctx.waitUntil — workerd cancels → fixed.
entries.guard: worker tests 34/34; live validation; §9 trap 10.

entries.title: Rate Limiting API is not enforced on the account's plan (experiment)
entries.rootCause: The [[ratelimits]] binding deploys and is visible, but limit() returns success: true on all requests even with limit=10 → the runtime does not enforce. Likely requires Workers Paid.
entries.fix: Experiment documented; reverted to limit=300. Bindings stay — they start working on upgrade without code changes. Code is fail-open.
entries.guard: EXPERIMENTS_LOG.md#7 (negative result); KI-007 updated.

entries.title: get_articles smoke failed: \"count\" escaping in SSE + live without the fix
entries.rootCause: The smoke searched for "count", but in the SSE tools/call response the field lives inside a JSON text string and is escaped (\"count\") — the grep never matched.
entries.fix: Smoke pattern → grep -q count (without quotes); the worker with fixes needs a manual deploy.
entries.guard: smoke runs on every push; worker tests cover tools/call locally.

entries.title: MCP endpoint hardening: rate limit, readOnlyHint, security headers, KI-006/KI-008
entries.rootCause: KI-006 — dev.to 403 on headerless fetches from datacenter egress; KI-007 — no rate limit existed; KI-008 — llm_saturation no-op without an honest explanation.
entries.fix: UA + snapshot fallback; [[ratelimits]] 300/60 + CHAT 30/60; readOnlyHint/openWorldHint on all tools; security headers; honest 'no LLM stage' finding; CI smoke tools/call; AE telemetry.
entries.guard: tests/worker.test.ts (12 integration); tests/mcp-tools.test.ts; result 29/29 tests, typecheck, build.

entries.title: ONNX migration: 7 critical bugs fixed while moving off LM Studio
entries.rootCause: LM Studio is an external process requiring manual startup/setup; the status API hardcoded 'lm_studio' as the provider, so it lied when port 1234 was closed.
entries.fix: Replaced the hardcoded provider string with a real port probe; migrated embeddings + reranking to a local ONNX Runtime. All 50 tools work in ONNX mode (v2.7.0).
entries.guard: intel_get_runtime_status now reflects the real runtime; docs/en/investigations/ONNX_SESSION_REPORT.md.

entries.title: LSP investigation: custom Python LSP cannot register in Zed (WONTFIX)
entries.rootCause: Zed settings.json can only override KNOWN LSPs — it cannot register a new language server name; a pygls-based server is never started (verified on Zed 1.9.0 and 1.14.2).
entries.fix: WONTFIX the editor LSP. Deprecated the LSP→MCP bridge (writer lsp_main.py removed 2026-07-20); replaced with LspClient spawning basedpyright as a subprocess → 3 MCP tools (lsp_find_references / lsp_find_definition / lsp_document_symbols).
entries.guard: docs/en/investigations/LSP_WONTFIX.md; re-verified on Zed 1.14.2 (2026-08-06).

entries.title: Public GitHub export date ≠ production start date
entries.rootCause: The repo was exported publicly on 2026-06-06, but production ran since 2026-05-02 — an external reviewer could mistake the export date for the project's age.
entries.fix: docs/HONEST_POSITIONING.md documents the timeline explicitly: public export ≠ project born yesterday; production metrics cover 2026-05-02 → 2026-06-05.
entries.guard: PRODUCTION_EVIDENCE_REPORT.md ties measured numbers to git-verifiable artifacts.

entries.title: Memory retrieval is a substring stub (self-assessed 4/10)
entries.rootCause: Default memory retrieval is substring-based — simple but weak for semantic recall; the maintainer self-assessed it 4/10 and recommends Mem0 for production-grade retrieval.
entries.fix: Documented honestly in HONEST_POSITIONING.md (self-assessed scores table); option to plug a Mem0 server for real retrieval.
entries.guard: Honest positioning doc keeps the gap visible for humans and tools.

entries.title: SDK v2 supports annotations.readOnlyHint (verified via tsc)
entries.rootCause: — (capability verification)
entries.fix: Temporary registerTool edit → tsc OK → revert. MCP spec 2026-07-28 introduces annotations; SDK v2 types readOnlyHint.
